label: An application of a rule is DETERMINED_2 only if some INTERPRETATION_1 of it is itself DETERMINED_2
paraphrase: Open premise, unattributed: an application of a rule (or an interpretation of it) is determined only if some interpretation of it is itself determined. This is the assumption PU §201 diagnoses as a misunderstanding ('jedes Handeln nach der Regel sei ein Deuten'), not a view attributed to Wittgenstein.
